full_prompt_en: A square cinematic digital portrait shows a young woman holding playing cards between two serious men in dark suits against a nearly black background. The trio is framed tightly from head to upper torso, with little setting beyond two small pink-white points of light behind them. The woman stands in the center and looks directly at the viewer beneath blunt dark bangs. Straight black hair falls to her shoulders, and her pale face is lit in cool blue-green tones. A sleeveless black dress covered in tiny reflective flecks catches sparse highlights across the chest. She holds a fan of white playing cards near the lower right, their red and black suit marks visible but not individually central to the scene. The man at left is partly cropped by the border; he wears a white shirt, black tie, and dark jacket, and holds a darker card near the lower left. The man on the right faces forward in a similar suit, his hair falling over the forehead and his expression unsmiling. Their pale collars and ties create narrow vertical light shapes beside the woman's dark dress. Round backlights glow beside the central head, producing pink rims on hair and shoulders while leaving the outer corners almost black. A cooler frontal fill reveals eyes and faces without removing the heavy shadow. Skin appears smooth and photographic, and the dress's glitter gives a fine grain of bright texture against matte suits. The three figures overlap as a compact line, with the woman advanced slightly and the men acting as dark symmetrical flanks. There is no legible signage or environment detail. The overall composition is tense and theatrical, using controlled neon color, near-symmetry, and selective card accents to suggest a high-stakes encounter.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感数字肖像呈现一名年轻女子持着扑克牌，站在两名神情严肃的深色西装男子之间，背景近乎黑色。三人从头到上半身被紧紧框住，环境除身后两点粉白光外几乎不可见。女子立在中央，平齐的深色刘海下直视观者。直黑发垂至肩头，浅色面孔受冷蓝绿光照亮。无袖黑裙胸前布满细小反光点，接住稀疏高光。她在右下附近展开一扇白色扑克牌，可见红黑花色标记，但每张具体点数不是画面重点。左侧男子部分被边框裁掉，穿白衬衫、黑领带和深外套，在左下握着一张更暗的牌。右侧男子穿类似正装正面站立，头发落在额前，表情不苟言笑。他们的浅色领口和领带在女子深裙旁形成狭长亮形。圆形背光在中央头部两侧发亮，沿发丝与肩膀留下粉色轮廓，而外侧角落几乎全黑。较冷的正面补光显出眼睛与脸，却不抹掉厚重阴影。皮肤平滑而带摄影感，裙子的闪粉在哑光西装前产生细小亮颗粒。三人紧凑地重叠成一列，女子略靠前，男子成为对称深色侧翼。没有可读招牌或环境细节。整体构图紧张而戏剧化，以受控霓虹色、近对称和少量扑克牌重音暗示一场高风险对峙。
style_prompt_en: The cinematic digital look compresses a small ensemble into a near-symmetric, shadow-heavy arrangement. Matte black clothing and a black field occupy most of the frame, while cool teal facial light and narrow magenta rims separate the forms. Tiny specular flecks and a few pale rectangular accents become important because the rest stays subdued. Skin is smooth and realistic, with selective sharpness around eyes and hands; the background holds only sparse blurred light sources. Opposed backlight and frontal fill produce depth without a visible room. Tight cropping and aligned vertical forms create controlled tension. The overall effect is sleek and secretive, driven by low-key lighting, restrained neon color, and the contrast between matte darkness and scattered bright details.
style_prompt_zh: 这种电影感数字画面把一小组形体压进近对称、阴影浓重的安排。哑光黑衣与黑色底域占去画面大部分，冷青绿脸光和狭窄品红轮廓则把形体分开。细小镜面闪点与少数浅色矩形重音因为其余部分低调而格外重要。皮肤平滑写实，眼睛与手周围选择性锐利；背景只保留稀疏模糊光源。相对的背光与正面补光无需可见房间也能制造纵深。紧凑裁切和对齐的竖向形体产生受控紧张感。整体效果光洁而隐秘，由低调照明、克制霓虹色，以及哑光黑暗与零星亮细节的对比驱动。
theme_en: A woman holding playing cards between two suited men under neon backlights
theme_zh: 一名持扑克牌的女子站在两名西装男子之间，身后有霓虹背光
name: Liar Game
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
